usage: pdl throttle [-h] [--targets TARGETS_FILE] [--domestic DOMESTIC_URLS]
                    [--plan-mbps PLAN_MBPS] [--isp ISP]
                    [--via-proxy VIA_PROXY] [--interface INTERFACE]
                    [--ipv4 | --ipv6] [--data-budget DATA_BUDGET]
                    [-o OUTPUT_DIR] [--html] [--run-id RUN_ID] [--force]
                    [--allow-32] [--seed SEED] [--host SERVER_HOST]
                    [--port SERVER_PORT] [--udp-port SERVER_UDP_PORT]
                    [--duration SERVER_DURATION] [--json] [-y]
                    [--non-interactive]
                    [{quick,full,sample,coverage,launchd-plist,report,server,targets}]
                    [extra_args ...]

ISP Throttling & Traffic Differentiation Diagnostic Suite.

positional arguments:
  {quick,full,sample,coverage,launchd-plist,report,server,targets}
                        Diagnostic subcommand to run.
  extra_args            Optional positional arguments (e.g. output path or
                        run_id).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --targets TARGETS_FILE
                        Path to custom targets.toml file.
  --domestic DOMESTIC_URLS
                        Domestic (in-country / BDIX / local peering) host or
                        URL (repeatable).
  --plan-mbps PLAN_MBPS
                        Subscribed ISP plan speed in Mbps (e.g. 50).
  --isp ISP             ISP display name for headers and evidence summary
                        (default: auto-detected from network).
  --via-proxy VIA_PROXY
                        Optional HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy URL for paired M9
                        comparison (secrets redacted in logs/reports).
  --interface INTERFACE
                        Preferred network interface name (e.g. en0).
  --ipv4                Force IPv4 target resolution.
  --ipv6                Force IPv6 target resolution.
  --data-budget DATA_BUDGET
                        Hard total data budget (e.g. 300MB, 3GB).
  -o OUTPUT_DIR, --output OUTPUT_DIR
                        Directory to write report files or LaunchAgent plist.
  --html                Generate self-contained HTML report with inline SVG
                        charts (default: True).
  --run-id RUN_ID       Specific stored run ID to rebuild with `pdl throttle
                        report`.
  --force               Bypass 45-minute sample idempotency window or battery
                        skip.
  --allow-32            Allow 32-stream probe in M3 flow scaling (default cap
                        is 16).
  --seed SEED           RNG seed for deterministic jitter and test ordering.
  --host SERVER_HOST    Bind address for `pdl throttle server` (default:
                        127.0.0.1).
  --port SERVER_PORT    TCP port for `pdl throttle server` (default: 8765).
  --udp-port SERVER_UDP_PORT
                        UDP echo port for `pdl throttle server` (default:
                        8766).
  --duration SERVER_DURATION
                        Optional duration in seconds for `pdl throttle
                        server`.
  --json                Emit structured JSON output to stdout.
  -y, --yes             Automatic confirmation for non-interactive runs.
  --non-interactive     Run without interactive prompts.
